biggest_catch: Close the account within 12 months and Bankers Trust charges a $400 early-closing fee — the entire bonus is wiped out if you bail early.
catches: A $400 early-closing fee applies if the account is closed within 12 months of opening.
The account must be opened in person with a $25 opening deposit.

Within 60 days of opening: complete 25 qualifying debits (ACH, Bankers Trust bill pay, checks, or debit-card purchases — ATM withdrawals excluded) and two direct ACH and/or mobile deposits of at least $200 each (ATM, teller, and account transfers excluded).
Existing checking customers and anyone with a Bankers Trust checking account in the prior six months are excluded; one bonus per household.
A $10.99 inactivity fee applies unless the account receives $500 in ACH/mobile deposits per statement cycle or the primary owner is 55+.
The account must remain open with a positive balance through payout.

steps: Open a Direct Checking Plus account in person with a $25 opening deposit.
Within 60 days of opening: complete 25 qualifying debits — ACH transactions, Bankers Trust bill pay, checks, or debit-card purchases. ATM withdrawals do not count.
Within the same 60 days: receive two direct ACH and/or mobile deposits of at least $200 each. ATM deposits, teller deposits, and account transfers do not count.
Keep the account open with a positive balance through payout — and do not close it within 12 months, or a $400 early-closing fee applies.
Receive the $400 bonus within 75 days of account opening, after the bank reviews the requirements at day 60.
